description: Cited research findings about the external world, distilled from prior web research and verified across sources: software release versions and feature lists (e.g. 'key features of Go 1.26', 'latest stable Rust version'), current events, third-party vendor and product facts, and other 'what is the latest X' answers. Route here for ANY external-world factual question — the store may already hold the verified, citation-backed answer (project-scope knowledge) without touching the live internet. Not for questions about this project's own code, scenarios, configuration, or how past work here was done.
